beatbox.screen.settings.title: Settings
beatbox.screen.settings.blurb: How BeatBox behaves, what this computer can give it, and where it keeps things.
beatbox.settings.language_note: All of BeatRooter changes, not only BeatBox, and it is remembered for next time.
beatbox.settings.close_what: What happens to machines still running. Left running, they are found again when BeatBox opens.
beatbox.settings.builder_what: Engine and Foundations, for whoever is building BeatBox itself.
beatbox.settings.state.full: Machines run here, at full speed.
beatbox.settings.all_here: Everything a machine needs is here.
beatbox.settings.optional_missing: Everything a machine needs is here. Some optional parts are not.
beatbox.settings.something_missing: Something a machine needs is missing. Setup can usually put it in place.
beatbox.settings.memory_can: A new machine can have up to {amount} right now.
beatbox.settings.can.qemu_what: Start a computer of its own inside this one.
beatbox.settings.can.kvm_what: Machines use the processor directly instead of imitating one.
beatbox.settings.can.terminal_what: Type into a machine from BeatBox.
beatbox.settings.machines.title: A new machine starts with
beatbox.settings.machines.what: What the new machine form is filled with. You can still change any one machine in its own settings.
beatbox.settings.machines.too_much: More than this computer has free right now.
beatbox.settings.machines.reach_what: Where it can reach as soon as it is made.
beatbox.settings.machines.agent_what: Commands and Watchers need this. The machine needs its guest agent too.
beatbox.settings.machines.fits: It fits, with {left} left over for everything else.
beatbox.settings.machines.would_not: It would not start: this computer has {free} free. Give it less, or stop another machine first.
beatbox.settings.storage.machines_what: What each machine has written since it was made, the biggest first. A machine that is off can go, and its space with it.
beatbox.settings.storage.disks_what: What machines are made from, the biggest first. Deleting one deletes the machines made from it too.
beatbox.settings.storage.left_title: {amount} left by machines that are gone
beatbox.settings.storage.left_what: BeatBox was closed before it could tidy up. Nothing in it is yours to keep.
beatbox.settings.about.guest_what: Everything stays on this computer. There is no account anywhere.
beatbox.settings.about.wrong_what: What to send along with a bug report.
beatbox.settings.about.engine_what: What runs your machines while this window is closed.
beatbox.settings.about.log_what: Everything the engine did, in order.
beatbox.settings.about.folder_what: Machines, disks and settings, all in one place.
beatbox.settings.about.copy: Copy details for a bug report
beatbox.settings.storage.delete_ask: Delete {name}? The {amount} it takes go with it.
beatbox.settings.storage.stop_first: Stop it first, on its own page.
beatbox.settings.storage.delete_ask_made: Delete {name}? {names} are made from it and go with it: {amount} in all.
beatbox.settings.storage.last_chance: Last chance: delete it for good?
beatbox.settings.storage.no_undo: There is no bin. Once it is gone, it is gone.
beatbox.settings.storage.delete_ask_made: Delete {name}? {names} is made from it and goes with it: {amount} in all.
